Original:
Kehti Thi Kya Kya Malal Jhele Hon Ge
Behna Nahi Pas Kise Khelay Hon Ge
Raat Andheri Daro Na Jangle Main
Asghar Mere Qabar Main Akele Hon Ge
Maa Kehti Thi,
Translation:
She would say, 'What sorrows he must have endured.
His sister is not beside him to play with him.
The night is dark—do not be afraid in the wilderness.
My Asghar will be alone in his grave.'
The mother would say,

Original:
Na Milega Na Milega
Jhoola To Nazar Aayega Asghar Na Milega
Ab Sari Khudai Main Asghar Na Milega
Translation:
He will not be found, he will not be found.
The cradle will still be there, but Asghar will not.
In all the world, Asghar will no longer be found.

Original:
Ab Jhula Jhulane Ko Taras Jayengi Bahain
Khayme Mein Kabhi Dasht Me Dhundengi Nigahe
Thak Jayengi Ye Ankhe, Asghar Na Milega
Translation:
These arms will long to rock his cradle.
My eyes will search for him in the tents and across the desert.
These eyes will grow weary—Asghar will not be found.

Original:
Saaye Me Na Jawungi Tu Ghar Laut Ke Ajaa
Har Waqt Mere Honto Per Honga Hehi Noha
Bin Tere Sukoo Maa Ko, Asghar Na Milega
Translation:
I will never seek the shade; just come home.
This lament will forever remain upon my lips.
Without you, your mother will never find peace, Asghar.

Original:
Dhayenge Layee'n Ham Per Abhi Aur Qayamat
Dhundenge Shaki Dasht Me Beshir Ki Turbat
Shuhada Ke Saro Me Jab, Asghar Na Milega
Translation:
The tyrants will still bring more calamities upon us.
They will search the desert for Besheer's grave.
Among the martyrs, Asghar will not be found.

Original:
Zindan Se Riha Ho Kar Jab Jayenge Ham Ghar
Har Goud Me Dhundengi Bohat Roye Gi Muztar
Jab Fatema Sughra Ko, Asghar Na Milega
Translation:
When we are released from the prison and return home,
Every mother's lap will be searched, and the distressed will weep.
When Fatima Sughra does not find Asghar.

Original:
Hathon Me Uthaongi Jab Pani Ka Kuza
Pani Me Nazar Aayegaa Besheer Ka Chehra
Bas Aas Nazar Aayegaa, Asghar Naa Milega
Translation:
Whenever I lift a water vessel in my hands,
I will see Besheer's face reflected in the water.
Only his memory will remain—Asghar will not be found.

Original:
Asghar Ke Shaluke Jab Nazar Ayenge Ghar Me
Ik Dard Sa Us Waqt Bhi Uthe Ga Jigar Me
Sab Honge Wahan Lekin, Asghar Na Milega
Translation:
When Asghar's little clothes are seen at home,
A fresh pain will rise in the heart.
Everyone will be there—but Asghar will not.

Original:
Kya Beet Gai Ho Gi Uss Maa Ke Jigar Par
Socho To Zara Kehta Hai Irfan Se Mazhar
Jab Sheh Ne Kaha Ho Ga Asghar Na Mile Ga
Translation:
Imagine what that mother's heart must have endured.
Think for a moment, says Mazhar to Irfan,
When the Master said, 'Asghar will not be found.'
